jess_support: FYI customer (acct acme-corp) reporting intermittent 400 from embeddings endpoint. says it started after yesterday's traffic spike. payload attached in case it helps.

mike_sre: can you paste the exact error? 400 type usually dim mismatch or payload shape.

jess_support: error is `400 Bad Request: embedding dimension mismatch (expected=1536, received=768)`. Happens ~1-2% of calls in a 30m window. sample curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' -d '{"model":"open-embed-large","input":["text1","text2"]}'```

ryan_ml: that expected dim 1536 is for our open-embed-large. received 768 suggests some requests routed to a smaller-variant (quantized /-lite) or client sent older model header. Do we have routing logs?

olivia_platform: pulled routing logs for customer, looks like ~2% of requests were routed to variant `open-embed-large-qlite` around timestamp 2025-11-02T14:05Z. routing policy shows weight-based fallback under high load.

jess_support: customer insists they always call model param `open-embed-large`. no model override in their code.

mike_sre: theory: dynamic batching + max_batch_size split + variant coalescing. If dyn-batcher mixes requests for large+lite variants due to policy fallback, the batch payload may be assumed same dim but backend produces 768 vectors for some. Leads to mismatch at SDK side when combining.

ryan_ml: possible. also saw a related bug where `max_batch_size` boundary causes batcher to flush mid-assemble and pick a different model variant for the tail. config: `dynamic_batching: true, max_batch_size: 64, batch_window_ms: 12`. Under thundering-few-large requests we had shard imbalance.

olivia_platform: deploy-bot: ```deploy-bot: rolled out routing-fix v2025.11.02.3 to production at 2025-11-02T13:50Z``` — that matches timeframe.

mike_sre: can we repro in staging? steps: 1) set model traffic to 90% large, 10% lite via policy 2) flood with many small requests to trigger dynbatch coalescing 3) observe if any batches contain mixed-variant frames and whether server returns 768 vectors then upstream rejects.

ryan_ml: will write a quick repro script. also check KV cache tagging: if KV tokens come from different variant caching keys we might be hitting cache-mismatch too.

jess_support: customer also saw a billing spike metric alert at same time, billing_bot: `billing_bot: noticed 18% uplift in token chargeable units for acme-corp between 13:40-14:10 UTC`. customer concerned we double-charged for retries.

billing_bot: `billing_bot: created ticket BLG-987 to audit charge events; flagged potential retry loop from client SDK after 400s`.

olivia_platform: action items: (a) ry an_ml to run repro in staging and capture batch headers (b) mike_sre to check batcher logs for mixed-variant decisions (c) finance to audit BLG-987 and pause invoice if needed.

ryan_ml: starting repro now — I'll push logs to /var/tmp/repro-5990011223.log and link when done. expect results in ~30m.

mike_sre: quick mitigation: temporarily lower fallback weight for lite variant for affected model or bump `max_batch_size` to reduce flushes. leaning to weight change to avoid changing perf.

jess_support: told customer we are investigating and suggested a temporary retry-backoff on client side. customer ACKed. :thumbsup:

olivia_platform: noted. will keep thread updated. if repro confirms bug we'll open a runtime-hotfix.

deploy-bot: `deploy-bot: canary routing-fix health checks stable (5/5) at 2025-11-02T14:10Z`

ryan_ml: repro logs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/attic/repro-5990011223.log — summary: confirmed dynbatch sometimes coalesces heterogeneous model-variant requests when fallback race hits during max_batch_size flush. producing mixed-dim outputs triggers client-side 400. created runtime bug RN-4521.

mike_sre: RN-4521 prioritized P1 for runtime-team. workaround: set model policy to disable variant fallback for now. I'll open PR to change weights.

jess_support: closing loop with customer, will update once runtime patch lands. thanks everyone.
